insight: A Y Combinator S23 company (legal entity AutoInfra), founded by Tejas Bhakta.
name: Morph
tagline: Fast models that apply AI code edits to files in milliseconds.
description: Infrastructure for coding agents centered on Fast Apply, a specialized model that merges AI-generated edits into files at ~10,500 tokens/sec instead of full-file rewrites or brittle search-and-replace. Also serves WarpGrep code search, context compaction, and a model router via an OpenAI-compatible API. Used in production by JetBrains, Vercel, and Webflow.

modelSupport.notes: Hosts a proprietary Fast Apply model plus open models behind one API.

edge: A dedicated Fast Apply model that merges LLM code edits at ~10,500 tok/s — purpose-built write layer for agents.
pros: Used in production by JetBrains, Vercel
Adds code search and context compaction
cons: Most useful only inside coding agents
